description.zh: 共享型云电脑的计费方式。
description.en:
The billing method of the cloud computer share.

Valid values:

- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

- PrePaid: subscription.
The IDs of the cloud computer shares.
The name of the cloud computer share.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑的授权用户ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the users to be authorized.

description.zh: 包年包月共享型云电脑的到期时间。
description.en: The expiration date of the subscription cloud computer share.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

- 最大值：100。
- 默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The token that determines the start point of the next query. If this parameter is left empty, all results are returned.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑所属的办公网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the office network.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑关联的策略ID。
description.en: The ID of the security policy.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. You cannot specify an empty string as a tag key. A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. You can specify an empty string as a tag key. A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 导出共享型云电脑列表
